title: Piyush Goyal meets US business leaders, seeks investments in India
description:
Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal on Monday met US business leaders and discussed opportunities to further deepen partnerships and investments in India.
Goyal met  Jonathan Gray, President & COO of Blackstone, George Walker, Chairman and CEO of Nueberger Berman, and  Stephane de La Faverie, President & CEO of The Estee Lauder Companies in New York.
"Held a productive meeting with Mr. Jonathan Gray, President & COO of @Blackstone along with Mr. Prakash Melwani, Chairman of Blackstone's International Private Equity business," Goyal said in a post on X.
"Discussed opportunities to deepen Blackstone's investment and partnership in India and explored avenues across key sectors. I look forward to our continued engagement and stronger collaboration," the minister said.
